overview_description.description: Snaptrude is a cloud-based collaborative 3D building design tool that enhances teamwork and productivity in architectural design. The company allows users to link program data directly to 3D models, ensuring that any updates in data are instantly reflected in the design. The tool integrates automation and intelligent building information modeling (BIM) to streamline the design process, similar to using Figma for graphic design.

about_short_description.short_description: Snaptrude is a cloud-based collaborative 3D building design tool that enhances teamwork and productivity in architectural design.

product.name: Snaptrude Collaborative Building Design Tool
product.description: A cloud-based platform for architectural design that supports real-time collaboration, automated BIM creation, and detailed drawing generation.

product.name: Snaptrude BIM Mode
product.description: A feature that transforms conceptual massing studies into detailed BIM assemblies within the same cloud-based platform, enabling parametric updates and Revit integration.

product.name: Snaptrude Rhino Import
product.description: A tool to import native Rhino (.3dm) models into Snaptrude, preserving complex geometry and enabling BIM property assignment and documentation.

product.name: Snaptrude Sun Hours Analysis
product.description: An integrated tool for real-time sunlight exposure and shadow analysis within the design environment to optimize daylighting and compliance.

product.name: Snaptrude Terrain-Aware Design
product.description: A feature enabling import and modeling on real-world contour sites with live elevation data and cut-and-fill visualization.

product.name: Snaptrude and ARES Commander Integration
product.description: A workflow combining Snaptrude’s automated BIM creation with ARES Commander’s CAD capabilities to generate construction drawings from BIM models.
